what: Run BLISA at the LR level
title: Visium profile of human breast tumour
text: blisa() everything one call: spatial weights, LR pair filtering CellChatDB, bivariate Moran’s per LR pair, hotspot identification. However, Visium data spot-based, cell type annotation default. Therefore, blisa() doesn’t calculate cell-cell interaction scoring imaging-based data Xenium. result blisa object five slots: Level - whether LR level pathway level LR_results — one row per LR pair, sorted number hotspot bins bins — hexagonal grid sf object spatial_weights — queen distance-decay weights computeSpatialWeights() CCI_scores — wide data frame sender-receiver interaction scores per LR pair
code: res <- blisa(spe)  #> Downloading CellChatDB.human from GitHub (once per session)... #> Testing 462 LR pairs... #>   |========================================| 100% res #> A blisa object #>  Level            : lr  #>  LR pairs tested  : 462  #>  Significant      : 462  #>  Bins             : 4412  #>  CCI computed     : FALSE

what: Run BLISA at the pathway level
title: Visium profile of human breast tumour
text: perform pathway level cell-cell communication analyses, run blisaPathway(). default, pathway level result union LR pair’s significant hotspot spots, minimum (best) p-value per spot. Two alternative methods, Simes’ Fisher’s methods, supported combine p-values LR pair’s across hotspot spots.
code: res_pathway <- blisaPathway(res) res_pathway #> A blisa object #>  Level            : pathway  #>  Pathways tested  : 100  #>  Significant      : 100  #>  Bins             : 4412  #>  CCI computed     : FALSE

title: Exploring cell-cell interaction with blisa
text: blisa identifies spatially enriched ligand-receptor (LR) interactions spatial transcriptomics data using bivariate Local Moran’s (LISA) statistics. core idea bin cells hexagonal grid, compute spatial co-enrichment every ligand-receptor pair across bins, flag “High-High” hotspot bins partners spatially co-expressed beyond chance. vignette walks typical workflow Xenium breast cancer dataset.

title: Exploring cell-cell interaction with blisa
text: hexBinCells() aggregates cells hexagonal bins. group argument supplied (, cell type), also returns per-cell-type bin matrices counts_by_group, needed downstream CCI scoring spatial visualisation.
code: coords <- as.data.frame(SpatialExperiment::spatialCoords(spe)) counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(spe, "counts")  binned <- hexBinCells(   coords_df     = coords,   counts_matrix = counts,   bin_size      = 50,   group         = spe$cell_type )  # Components: #   binned$counts_matrix   - gene x bin sparse matrix (all cells) #   binned$bins            - sf polygons (with n_cells column) #   binned$counts_by_group - named list of gene x bin matrices, one per cell type

title: Exploring cell-cell interaction with blisa
text: blisa() everything one call: spatial weights, LR pair filtering CellChatDB, bivariate Moran’s per LR pair, hotspot identification, (counts_by_group supplied) cell-cell interaction scoring. result blisa object four slots: LR_results — one row per LR pair, sorted number hotspot bins bins — hexagonal grid sf object spatial_weights — queen distance-decay weights computeSpatialWeights() CCI_scores — wide data frame sender-receiver interaction scores per LR pair
code: res <- blisa(   binned$counts_matrix,   bins            = binned$bins,   n_cells_col     = "n_cells",   counts_by_group = binned$counts_by_group ) #> Downloading CellChatDB.human from GitHub (once per session)... #> Testing 12 LR pairs... #>   |========================================| 100%  res #> A blisa object #>  LR pairs tested  : 12  #>  Significant pairs: 12  #>  Bins             : 17215  #>  CCI computed     : TRUE

what: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
title: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
text: Generic function running BLISA (Bivariate Local Indicator Spatial Association). Dispatches class x: blisa.default accepts pre-binned gene--bin count matrix matching bins polygon object. blisa.SpatialExperiment accepts cell-level SpatialExperiment object bins cells hexagonal tiles internally via hexBinCells running analysis.

title: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
code: blisa(x, ...)  # Default S3 method blisa(   x,   bins,   LR_df = NULL,   bin_size = 50,   dmax = 250,   nsim = 999,   p_cutoff = 0.05,   min_ligand = 10,   min_receptor = 10,   min_cells = 1,   n_cells_col = NA,   annotation_col = "annotation",   default_mode = "diffuse",   diffuse_category = c("Secreted Signaling", "Non-protein Signaling"),   species = c("human", "mouse"),   genes = NULL,   counts_by_group = NULL,   fast = TRUE,   cpu_threads = 4L,   verbose = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'SpatialExperiment' blisa(   x,   bin_size = 50,   LR_df = NULL,   group = "cell_type",   genes = NULL,   min_cells = 1,   min_total_counts = 10,   platform = c("auto", "xenium", "visium"),   verbose = FALSE,   ... )

title: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
text: x gene--bin count matrix (blisa.default) cell-level SpatialExperiment object (blisa.SpatialExperiment). ... Additional arguments passed relevant method. bins sf object bin polygons. Row order must match column order x. LR_df Data frame ligand-receptor pairs columns ligand.symbol receptor.symbol. NULL, CellChatDB chosen species downloaded automatically. bin_size Numeric. Width hexagonal bin coordinate units (e.g. microns). Passed hexBinCells computeSpatialWeights. Default 50; Visium path defaults 100 (spot center--center spacing) left unset. dmax Numeric. Maximum distance diffuse-mode neighbours. Default 250. nsim Integer. Number permutations Moran's significance. Default 999. p_cutoff Numeric. P-value threshold High-High hotspots. Default 0.05. min_ligand Numeric. Minimum ligand count threshold. Default 10. min_receptor Numeric. Minimum receptor count threshold. Default 10. min_cells Integer. Minimum number cells per bin. SpatialExperiment, bins threshold dropped binning hexBinCells. pre-binned input supplied directly blisa.default, dropped bins, x counts_by_group spatial weights built; requires n_cells_col ignored n_cells_col = NA. Default 1. n_cells_col Character NA. Column bins holding per-bin cell counts used min_cells filtering. Set NA skip (default). annotation_col Character. Column LR_df specifying interaction category used communication-mode assignment. Default "annotation". default_mode Character. CCC mode assigned LR pairs whose annotation match diffuse_category. Default "diffuse". diffuse_category Character vector annotation categories treated diffuse signalling. species Character. CellChatDB download LR_df = NULL. One "human" (default) "mouse". genes Character vector gene names consider matching ligand-receptor pairs. Defaults rownames(x) (genes SpatialExperiment object). counts_by_group Named list gene--bin count matrices, one per group level (e.g. cell type), returned hexBinCells group supplied. provided, runCCI called automatically BLISA loop output included result CCI_scores. Default NULL. fast Logical. TRUE (default), uses fastLISA::local_moran_bv (fast C/OpenMP backend) bivariate local Moran's computation. FALSE, uses original spdep::localmoran_bv + spdep::hotspot pipeline. cpu_threads Integer. Number OpenMP threads used fastLISA::local_moran_bv. used fast = TRUE. Ignored platforms without OpenMP. Default 4L. verbose Logical. TRUE, print progress messages. Default FALSE (silent). group Character. Column name colData(x) use grouping variable (e.g. cell type) per-group bin aggregation downstream CCI analysis via runCCI. column found colData(x), message issued CCI skipped. Default "cell_type". min_total_counts Numeric. Bins whose total counts (summed genes) fall threshold dropped binning hexBinCells. Set 0 disable. Default 10. platform Character. "auto" (default) inspects colData(x): array_col/array_row present object treated "visium", otherwise "xenium". Set explicitly override detection.

title: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
text: list; see individual method documentation details. object class blisa four components: LR_results Data frame BLISA results LR pair, including ccc_mode, sig_numbers, sig_index, sig_pval, all_pval, all_lisa, all_quadrant, original columns LR_df. all_quadrant character vector hotspot quadrant labels ("High-High", "Low-Low", etc.) every bin; non-tested bins NA. bins Bin-level sf object hexagonal polygons. spatial_weights Spatial weights list computeSpatialWeights. CCI_scores NULL unless counts_by_group supplied, case wide data frame interaction scores runCCI: rows "Sender->Receiver" group pairs, columns LR pairs.

title: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
text: blisa(default): Method gene--bin count matrix. blisa(SpatialExperiment): Method cell-level SpatialExperiment object. cell-level platforms (e.g. Xenium) bins cells hexagonal tiles via hexBinCells; Visium treats spot bin via visiumSpotBins. Either way delegates blisa.default. path chosen platform.

title: Run BLISA spatial cell-cell communication analysis — blisa
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Download and cache the example Xenium breast cancer dataset (~21 MB) data_url  <- paste0(   "https://github.com/ChenLaboratory/example_data/releases/",   "download/v1.0.0/spe_xenium_bc_s1rep1.rds" ) cache_dir <- tools::R_user_dir("blisa", "cache") data_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "spe_xenium_bc_s1rep1.rds") if (!file.exists(data_file)) {   dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)   download.file(data_url, data_file, mode = "wb") } spe <- readRDS(data_file)  # blisa.SpatialExperiment method: bins cells, runs LISA, scores CCI result <- blisa(spe, bin_size = 50, group = "cell_type") result } # }

what: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
title: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
text: Rolls per-ligand-receptor (LR) pair BLISA hotspot results signalling pathway level, grouping LR pairs pathway annotation column (e.g. CellChatDB's pathway_name). pathway returns spots hotspots pathway, per-spot pathway p-value, LR pair driving spot.

title: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
code: blisaPathway(   x,   method = c("minP", "simes", "fisher"),   pathway_col = "pathway_name",   p_cutoff = 0.05,   p_adjust = c("none", "BH") )

title: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
text: x blisa object (LR_results data frame). method Character. Per-spot combination: "minP" (default, original behaviour), "simes", "fisher". pathway_col Character. Column LR_results holding pathway label. Default "pathway_name" (CellChatDB). Rows NA dropped. p_cutoff Numeric. Significance threshold "simes"/ "fisher". Default 0.05. Ignored "minP". p_adjust Character. Multiple-testing adjustment across spots "simes"/"fisher": "none" (default) "BH". Ignored "minP".

title: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
text: blisa object whose LR_results slot pathway-level table (one row per pathway, row names = pathway, ordered sig_numbers descending), standard blisa methods work directly (plotHotspots, plotLRrank, print). bins spatial_weights slots carried x (blisa object); CCI_scores NULL. LR_results columns : sig_numbers Number pathway hotspot spots. n_LR_pairs Number LR pairs annotated pathway. sig_index List column: hotspot spot indices. sig_pval List column: per-spot pathway p-values. LR_pairs List column: LR pair IDs pathway. top_LR_pair List column: per spot, LR pair(s) smallest contributing p-value.

title: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
text: per-spot pathway p-value computed one three methods: "minP"  "simes" Per-spot Simes combination across LR pairs pathway, using full per-spot p-values (all_pval) restricted High-High co-expression direction. Non-High-High/untested contributions set 1. "fisher" "simes" Fisher's method. "simes"/"fisher", spot pathway hotspot combined p-value \(\le\) p_cutoff (optional p_adjust).

title: Aggregate BLISA hotspots to the pathway level — blisaPathway
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ res <- blisa(spe, platform = "visium") blisaPathway(res)                          # min-P (original behaviour) blisaPathway(res, method = "simes", p_adjust = "BH") } # }

title: Compute Spatial Weights for BLISA — computeSpatialWeights
text: Builds queen (nearby) distance-decay (diffuse) spatial weight matrices bin-level sf object, excluding bins neighbours.

title: Compute Spatial Weights for BLISA — computeSpatialWeights
code: computeSpatialWeights(bins, bin_size = 50, dmax = 250)

title: Compute Spatial Weights for BLISA — computeSpatialWeights

Spot center--center spacing used bin_size. NULL (default) means: use 100 um array-index lattice, measure coordinates fallback. Supply number force (interpreted coordinate units). in_tissue_only Logical. Keep spots in_tissue == 1. Default TRUE. hexagons Logical. Row order matches columns counts_matrix. pitch spot spacing used (= recommended bin_size). coord_unit "micron", "pixel/", NA (spot_pitch supplied) – inferred coordinate unit.

title: Build spot-level hexagonal bins from a Visium SpatialExperiment — visiumSpotBins
text: Visium, spot already spatial bin, cell--bin aggregation needed (unlike hexBinCells). array_col increments 2 within row alternate rows shift array_col 1, half-row stagger already encoded indices; lattice therefore needs odd/even phase correction. bin centroids used computeSpatialWeights; hexagon polygons plotting (tessellate lattice exactly). array_col/array_row absent (e.g. SpatialExperiment built scider::readVisium()), function falls back using spatialCoords(spe) directly: spots still one bin , de-tilt/exact-lattice step skipped. case, spot_pitch NULL, pitch measured coordinates median nearest-neighbour distance. Since physical Visium pitch 100 um, 100 / pitch microns-per-unit; coordinates rescaled microns factor (near-identity already microns), returned pitch 100 downstream bin_size/dmax microns. instead supply spot_pitch, rescaling done everything stays coordinates' native units.

title: blisa 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-10 blisa() now uses fastLISA C/OpenMP backend default (fast = TRUE) bivariate local Moran’s computation. fastLISA moved Suggests Imports. Results statistically equivalent previous spdep::localmoran_bv backend bit-identical (different RNG). New min_total_counts argument blisa() hexBinCells() drops bins whose total counts (summed genes) fall threshold binning. Default 10. New verbose argument (default FALSE) blisa() hexBinCells() gates progress messages; blisa() also shows progress bar ligand-receptor pairs interactive sessions. New lr_pairs argument plotCCI() selects specific ligand-receptor pairs display, overriding top_lr. New main argument plotCCI(), plotCCILR(), plotCCIsummary() adds title heatmap.

title: blisa 0.2.3
text: LR_results row names now informative IDs built ligand/receptor symbols, subunits joined | two sides _ (e.g. TGFB1_TGFBR2|TGFBR1). original CellChatDB interaction_name retained new interaction_name column. plotCCIspatial() now handles multi-subunit ligand/receptor complexes (previously errored subscript bounds). plotHotspots(), plotCCIspatial(), plotCCILR() now match ligand/receptor arguments subunit set, independent order, separator (,, _, |), whitespace.
